
===== USER MESSAGE =====
L001 PRE[] WRAP[] TXT[ ▼ You  HH:MM:SS]
      FACES  =(opencode-user-header opencode-message-header-line) ▼=opencode-section-indicator  You  HH:MM:SS=(opencode-user-header opencode-message-header-line)
L002 PRE[▎ ] WRAP[] TXT[user asks **something**]
      FACES user asks **something**=opencode-user-body
L003 PRE[▎ ] WRAP[] TXT[- with a list]
      FACES - with a list=opencode-user-body
L004 PRE[] WRAP[] TXT[ ]
      FACES  =opencode-message-footer-line

===== ASSISTANT MESSAGE =====
L001 PRE[] WRAP[] TXT[ ▼ Assistant test-model HH:MM:SS]
      FACES  =(opencode-assistant-header opencode-message-header-line) ▼=opencode-section-indicator  Assistant test-model HH:MM:SS=(opencode-assistant-header opencode-message-header-line)
L002 PRE[▎] WRAP[] TXT[«(space :width 50)»]
      FACES  =opencode-step-separator
L003 PRE[▎] WRAP[] TXT[ ▼ Thinking...]
      FACES ▼=opencode-section-indicator  Thinking...=opencode-reasoning
L004 PRE[▎ ] WRAP[] TXT[thinking about **things**]
      FACES thinking about **things**=opencode-reasoning
L005 PRE[▎ ] WRAP[] TXT[second thought]
      FACES second thought=opencode-reasoning
L006 PRE[▎ ] WRAP[] TXT[Heading one]
      FACES Heading one=(opencode-md-header-1 opencode-assistant-body)
L007 PRE[▎ ] WRAP[] TXT[Heading two]
      FACES Heading two=(opencode-md-header-2 opencode-assistant-body)
L008 PRE[▎ ] WRAP[] TXT[Plain prose with bold, italic and inline code.]
      FACES Plain prose with =opencode-assistant-body bold=(opencode-md-bold opencode-assistant-body) , =opencode-assistant-body italic=(opencode-md-italic opencode-assistant-body)  and =opencode-assistant-body inline code=(opencode-md-inline-code opencode-assistant-body) .=opencode-assistant-body
L009 PRE[▎ ] WRAP[] TXT[Nested bold italic and a link.]
      FACES Nested =opencode-assistant-body bold italic=(opencode-md-bold-italic opencode-assistant-body)  and a =opencode-assistant-body link=(markdown-link-face opencode-assistant-body) .=opencode-assistant-body
L010 PRE[▎ ] WRAP[] TXT[1. ordered item]
      FACES 1.=(opencode-md-list-marker opencode-assistant-body)  ordered item=opencode-assistant-body
L011 PRE[▎ ] WRAP[] TXT[2. second ordered]
      FACES 2.=(opencode-md-list-marker opencode-assistant-body)  second ordered=opencode-assistant-body
L012 PRE[▎ ] WRAP[] TXT[- first item]
      FACES -=(opencode-md-list-marker opencode-assistant-body)  first item=opencode-assistant-body
L013 PRE[▎ ] WRAP[] TXT[- second item]
      FACES -=(opencode-md-list-marker opencode-assistant-body)  second item=opencode-assistant-body
L014 PRE[▎ ] WRAP[] TXT[* star item]
      FACES *=(opencode-md-list-marker opencode-assistant-body)  star item=opencode-assistant-body
L015 PRE[▎ ] WRAP[] TXT[> a blockquote line]
      FACES >=(opencode-md-blockquote opencode-md-blockquote opencode-assistant-body)  a blockquote line=(opencode-md-header-2 opencode-md-blockquote opencode-assistant-body)
L016 PRE[▎ ] WRAP[] TXT[]
L017 PRE[▎ ] WRAP[] TXT[]
L018 PRE[▎ ] WRAP[] TXT[(defun foo () (bar 1))]
      FACES (=(opencode-md-code-block opencode-assistant-body) defun=(font-lock-keyword-face opencode-md-code-block opencode-assistant-body)  =(opencode-md-code-block opencode-assistant-body) foo=(font-lock-function-name-face opencode-md-code-block opencode-assistant-body)  () (bar 1))=(opencode-md-code-block opencode-assistant-body)
L019 PRE[▎ ] WRAP[] TXT[]
L020 PRE[▎ ] WRAP[] TXT[trailing prose]
      FACES trailing prose=opencode-assistant-body
L021 PRE[▎] WRAP[] TXT[ ▶ bash ($ ls -la) · 1s                                ✓ [collapsed]]
      FACES ▶=opencode-section-indicator bash=opencode-tool-name ($ ls -la)=opencode-tool-arg · 1s=opencode-tool-duration ✓=opencode-tool-success  [collapsed]=font-lock-comment-face
L022 PRE[▎] WRAP[] TXT[]
L023 PRE[▎] WRAP[] TXT[]
L024 PRE[▎] WRAP[] TXT[]
L025 PRE[▎] WRAP[] TXT[ ▶ /review  review the diff  🤖 reviewer [collapsed]]
      FACES ▶=opencode-section-indicator /review=opencode-subtask-name   review the diff=opencode-subtask-description   🤖 reviewer=opencode-agent-badge  [collapsed]=font-lock-comment-face
L026 PRE[▎ ] WRAP[] TXT[]
L027 PRE[▎ ] WRAP[] TXT[]
L028 PRE[▎] WRAP[] TXT[ 📁 src/main.el]
      FACES  📁 src/main.el=opencode-mention-file
L029 PRE[▎] WRAP[] TXT[ 🤖 helper]
      FACES  🤖 helper=opencode-mention-agent
L030 PRE[▎] WRAP[] TXT[ Step: $0.0123]
      FACES Step: =opencode-step-summary $0.0123=opencode-cost
L031 PRE[▎] WRAP[] TXT[ · 12s ]
      FACES  · 12s =opencode-message-footer-line

===== STREAMING DELTAS =====
L001 PRE[▎ ] WRAP[] TXT[Streamed heading]
      FACES Streamed heading=(opencode-md-header-1 opencode-assistant-body)
L002 PRE[▎ ] WRAP[] TXT[with bold and]
      FACES with =opencode-assistant-body bold=(opencode-md-bold opencode-assistant-body)  and=opencode-assistant-body
L003 PRE[▎ ] WRAP[] TXT[- a list item]
      FACES -=(opencode-md-list-marker opencode-assistant-body)  a list item=opencode-assistant-body

===== STREAMING REASONING =====
L001 PRE[▎ ] WRAP[] TXT[reasoning **line**]
      FACES reasoning **line**=opencode-reasoning
L002 PRE[▎ ] WRAP[] TXT[second]
      FACES second=opencode-reasoning
